title: Berenberg Bank Wins an Award for Best Private Bank in Germany 2012
author: CFI.co Editorial
content_html:
Berenberg is one of Europe’s oldest financial institutions and brings a sense of duty to relationships with clients.

If you are looking for a private bank that fully understands the need to be open, transparent and accurate you will find that Berenberg Bank’s long heritage and accumulated knowledge has been put to good use.
